name: Team Squirtle: Bulky Dominance & Hydro Artillery
archetype: Water/Flying aerial artillery, Levitate hazard immunity, and electric speed sweeping.
gym_duel_rationale: The 5-battle gauntlet at Indigo Plateau requires unmatched endurance: Blastoise/Fearow provides Ground immunity and crushes Bruno and Blue's Fire/Ground threats with Hydro Pump; Alakazam/Weezing completely shuts down Bruno's Fighting squad with Psychic and pivots on Earthquakes; Jolteon/Sandslash outspeeds and electrocutes Lorelei's Water tanks with Discharge while setting up Swords Dance; Arbok/Primeape smashes Agatha's Ghost/Poison roster with Gunk Shot and Close Combat; Snorlax walls Mew with colossal HP and Body Slam; and Lapras freezes Lance's dragons with Ice Beam.

roster.progression_notes: 486 BST starter hybrid. Ground immunity and STAB Hydro Pump obliterate Bruno's Rock types and Blue's Rhydon/Magmortar. Drill Peck checks Fighting switch-ins.
495 BST Levitate pivot with 118 SpA. Levitate grants Ground immunity. Calm Mind-boosted Psychic sweeps Bruno's and Agatha's squads cleanly.
486 BST speed sweeper. Volt Absorb absorbs Electric moves. Swords Dance-boosted Earthquake demolishes Steel types, while Discharge paralyzes foes.
479 BST Intimidate bruiser. Intimidate neutralizes physical sweepers. Gunk Shot and Close Combat shred Fairy, Grass, Normal, and Steel types.
Colossal 160 HP tank. Complete Ghost immunity walls Agatha's team. Rest + Sleep Talk preserves health across the five consecutive battles.
535 BST Water/Ice wall. Ice Beam cleanly dismantles Lance's Flying and Dragon hybrids. Water Absorb completely counters Lorelei's Water STABs.

flex_bench.rationale: High-durability Grass/Poison tank packing Leech Seed and Sleep Powder.
Intimidate physical pivot and Dragon Dance sweeper with Aqua Tail.
Technician-boosted Triple Kick and Rapid Spin hazard removal.
